name: Seattle GeoData municipal catalog
capabilities: Data.gov identifies a current zoning-detail layer with zone types, overlays, ordinance numbers and effective dates. Native schema/query unverified.
licensing: Data.gov reports PDDL for the identified layer; primary item-level rights and any map/legal limitations remain to be reconciled. Do not transfer that license to all City datasets.

analysis_refs.heading: Technical failure or unfinished research — 44
analysis_refs.text: | [Seattle GeoData municipal catalog](https://data.seattle.gov/) | ArcGIS-host robots returned 403; other saved pages lacked usable layer details. | Identify the documented permitted municipal layer/query route; no key benefit established. Owner action: engineering/research first; no owner signup required yet. |

limitations: services.arcgis.com robots returned403; no target layer or query request sent.
Seattle Socrata homepage capture truncated before useful visible content; GeoData Hub pages rendered only titles in the text collector.
Data.gov explicitly says this is not an official zoning map. No legal zoning determination or personal owner/parcel records.

Catalog q keyword searches only, first3 metadata records; no individual asset/parcel/owner records. The title query parameter failed relevance. Native item IDs are not edition IDs and metadata modification times are not dataset vintage. Empty/paging controls remain unverified. Seed is a metadata projection with a separate stored hash, not raw HTTP bytes.
next_action: Maintain scoped public catalog q search. Test bounded empty/paging controls on a subsequent paced run; underlying feature services remain a separately blocked mode.
